title: Plan №1 — AzGuard 1.0 final hardening: governance, supply chain, qualification depth and release integrity
goal: Close the five P0 release blockers and the P1/P2 findings of the final 1.0 audit (audits/final/) so that AzGuard 1.0 is released from one protected, pinned, blocking and reproducibly qualified SHA: protected main and release tags, SHA-pinned and blocking CI security gates, a working disclosure channel, Laravel 12/13 consumer and critical mutation depth, and a verified split/Packagist RC with exact-SHA evidence. The kernel is not redesigned; runtime code changes only where an item names it.
context: Inputs: `audits/final/azguard-final-audit.md` and `audits/final/AzGuard 1.0 — углублённый финальный аудит и исполнимый план стабилизации.md` (audit of `93258463`, verdict CONDITIONAL NO-GO, readiness 8.5/10, CI supply chain 6/10). PLAN1 (`2026.10.10-№1-AZGUARD-CORE-STABILIZATION`) is done: modular core, API freeze, compatibility comparator, release graph and candidate `8a9c86f9` with baseline commit `c384a81a`. Observed facts (2026-10-17) are in knowledge/governance#facts and knowledge/supply-chain#inventory: no rulesets, `main` unprotected, single admin `academici`, no org teams, PVR and secret scanning disabled, `axiomasoft/azguard` exists private and non-empty, floating action tags, advisory Zizmor, `secrets: inherit`, docs deploy permissions in the release graph, consumer archives only on Laravel 13, mutation manual, root `composer.lock` gitignored, `SECURITY.md` pointing to `axioma-studio/azguard`. Owner answers 2026-10-17: D1 (PR + checks, 0 approvals, no bypass), D2 (archive old `axiomasoft/azguard`, fresh public mirrors), D3 (all tiers P0–P2), D4 (commit root lock). Phases: P1 CI supply chain and workflow gates → P2 security gates, disclosure and repository governance → P3 qualification depth → P4 release integrity up to the `v1.0.0-rc.1` GO record. The stable `v1.0.0` tag after the stabilization window is the owner's act after this plan.
non_goals: Redesigning the kernel, storage, lock granularity or public API; adding authorization features
Creating the stable v1.0.0 tag (owner act after the RC stabilization window)
Dynamic penetration testing by a third party
rules: Follow knowledge/execution#conventions in every item: branch feat/1.0-final-hardening, no push/tag/settings change without the named owner gate, owner WIP untouched, negative proof for every new gate.

Runtime code under packages/** changes only where an item scope names it or for a demonstrated defect with a failing test (knowledge/execution#conventions items 4 and 5); composer api:check and composer api:compat stay exit 0.
No unpinned action, image or tool anywhere (knowledge/supply-chain#pinning); no || true, continue-on-error or advisory mode on a gate.
Evidence lives under plans/2026.10.17-№1-AZGUARD-FINAL-HARDENING/artifacts/evidence/<item>/ with full SHA, command, exit code, counts and log path.

Owner 2026-10-17: only fast runs and tests. Slow runs (composer test, test:db, engines, extended fuzz, mutation, consumer-fixture) are impact-only, left to CI; fast checks (Arch, lint, analyse, targeted pest, docs) stay acceptance. Review (grok/grok-4.7) only at phase end, via the orchestrator bridge.
